adjudication.rationale: The diff does change the POST /admin/groups contract: `Admin::GroupsController#create` now reads `params[:name]` and `params[:visible]` (flat params) and no longer reads `params[:group][:name]` / `params[:group][:usernames]` (previous nested payload). It also no longer sets initial members (`group.usernames = ...` was removed), so any callers still sending the old nested payload (or expecting to add members at create-time) will either get validation errors (name becomes `''` when `params[:name]` is missing) or have usernames ignored. However, the accompanying JS and specs were updated to match this new contract, suggesting this is an intentional API change/compatibility concern rather than an accidental defect within this PR.
